definition.en: The stem of a plant, the part from the base up to the first branch. The word also means a tree or a pole.
definition.sw: Shina la mmea, sehemu kuanzia chini hadi tawi la kwanza. Neno hili pia lina maana ya mti au nguzo.
definition.dg: Kolo ra mmea, seemu kula photsi hadi panda ya kpwandza. Neno hiri piya ni dzina ra muhi mzima (mti), au ra chiguzo.

notes: To count as muhi, a stem must have a base (sina or kolo), so underground stems such as tubers and rhizomes are not mihi. Mgombato glosses muhi as 'non-cultivated plant, tree'.

definition.en: The base of the trunk, just above the ground.
definition.sw: Sehemu ya chini kabisa ya shina, juu kidogo ya ardhi.
definition.dg: Seemu ya photsi kabisa ya kolo, dzulu tu ya tsi.

meaning.en: Used of people for an ancestor or a person's place of birth.
meaning.sw: Kwa watu hutumika kumaanisha babu wa asili au mahali mtu alipozaliwa.
meaning.dg: Kpwa atu, nkuhumirwa kpwa mana ya mkare, au phahali mutu ariphovyalwa.

notes: Kolo means the same.

definition.en: Another word for sina, the base of the trunk just above the ground.
definition.sw: Neno jingine la sina, yaani sehemu ya chini kabisa ya shina, juu kidogo ya ardhi.
definition.dg: Neno ranjina ra *sina*, seemu ya photsi kabisa ya muhi, dzulu tu ya tsi.

meaning.en: Used of people for ancestry or historical links.
meaning.sw: Kwa watu hutumika kumaanisha nasaba au uhusiano wa kihistoria.
meaning.dg: Kpwa atu, nkuhumirwa kpwa mana ya asili ya mutu (akare) au uhusiano wa chihistoria.

notes: Mgombato glosses kolo more broadly, as 'stem, tree trunk'.

definition.en: The bark of a tree.
definition.sw: Gome la mti.
definition.dg: Gada ra kondze ra muhi (gome).

meaning.en: Also the scab or cover over a wound. Pakia argues the Digo treat bark and skin as matching structures.
meaning.sw: Pia ni kigaga au ganda linalofunika kidonda. Pakia anahoji kwamba Wadigo huona gome na ngozi kuwa miundo inayolingana.
meaning.dg: Piya ni gada rinarokala dzulu ya chironda. Pakia anagomba kukala Adigo anaona gopha na ngozi ni vitu vinavyolingana.

definition.en: An injury or scar on the bark of a tree.
definition.sw: Jeraha au kovu kwenye gome la mti.
definition.dg: Phatu gopha ra muhi ririphorumira, au tsoga dzulu ya gopha.

meaning.en: Wound, sore.
meaning.sw: Jeraha, kidonda.
meaning.dg: Chironda cha mwiri.

notes: Pakia suggests the word passed from people to plants after gopha (wound cover) was used for bark.

definition.en: A ring cut by stripping the bark all the way round a stem, which kills the plant. Doing this is kupiga chilingo.
definition.sw: Pete inayokatwa kwa kubambua gome kuzunguka shina lote, jambo linaloua mmea. Kufanya hivyo huitwa kupiga chilingo.
definition.dg: Pete inayohendwa kpwa kuusa gopha kuzunguluka muhi wosi, na inaolaga mmea. Kuhenda hivi nkuihwa *kupiga chilingo*.

definition.en: Growths on bark, such as lichens.
definition.sw: Vitu vinavyoota juu ya gome, kama vile lichens.
definition.dg: Vitu vinavyomera dzulu ya gopha, dza *lichens*.

meaning.en: Hair; probably borrowed from Swahili nywele.
meaning.sw: Nywele; huenda limetoholewa kutoka neno la Kiswahili nywele.
meaning.dg: Nyere za chitswa (nywele); labuda neno hiri rikahalwa kula Chiswahili *nywele*.

definition.en: The wood inside a tree trunk.
definition.sw: Mbao zilizo ndani ya shina la mti.
definition.dg: Seemu ngumu ya ndani ya kolo ra muhi.

meaning.en: 'Meat of a tree': the grain looks like chunks of meat, and nyama is the inner substance of any living thing.
meaning.sw: 'Nyama ya mti': nyuzi za mbao zinafanana na vipande vya nyama, na nyama ni kiini cha ndani cha kiumbe chochote hai.
meaning.dg: 'Nyama ya muhi': misitari ya ndani ya muhi inaonekana dza vipande vya nyama, na *nyama* ni chitu cha ndani cha chila chiumbe chiricho na uzima.

notes: Coconut flesh and mushroom flesh are also called nyama. Wood is either chiini (heartwood) or bacha (sapwood).

definition.en: The heartwood at the centre of a trunk, found only in trees that grow thick with age. It lasts well and is preferred for carpentry and building.
definition.sw: Kiini cha mbao katikati ya shina, kinachopatikana tu katika miti inayonenepa kadiri inavyozeeka. Hudumu muda mrefu na hupendelewa kwa useremala na ujenzi.
definition.dg: Seemu iriyo kahi-kahi ya kolo, inayophahikana kpwa mihi tu inayonona kpwa kukala kpwa muda mrefu. Inakaa sana, kpwa hivyo inamendzwa zaidi kpwa kazi ya fundi wa mbao na kudzenga.

meaning.en: Purity; Pakia could not explain the link to heartwood.
meaning.sw: Usafi; Pakia hakuweza kueleza uhusiano wake na kiini cha mbao.
meaning.dg: Usafi; Pakia kaweza kueleza uhusiano wa neno hiri na chiini cha muhi.

notes: Mostly used by carpenters, pole cutters and builders, not part of general Digo plant knowledge.

definition.en: The softer outer wood of a trunk. Pests damage it, so it is less wanted for carpentry and building.
definition.sw: Mbao laini za nje za shina. Wadudu huziharibu, kwa hiyo hazipendelewi sana kwa useremala na ujenzi.
definition.dg: Seemu ya kondze ya kolo, iriyo laini kuriko *chiini*. Inabanangwa ni adudu, kpwa hivyo taimendzwa sana kpwa kazi ya fundi wa mbao na kudzenga.

notes: Like chiini, a word used mostly by timber users.

definition.en: A branch, or the Y-shaped fork where a stem divides.
definition.sw: Tawi, au panda yenye umbo la Y pale shina linapogawanyika.
definition.dg: Phungo ra muhi, au phatu muhi unaphogbwanyika phairi na kukala dza herufi *Y*.

meaning.en: Also 'to climb' and a catapult, which is made from a forked branch.
meaning.sw: Pia ina maana ya 'kupanda' (juu) na manati, ambayo hutengenezwa kwa tawi lenye panda.
meaning.dg: Piya rina mana ya 'kukpwera' (kukpwera muhi), na manati, ambayo nkuhendwa kula kpwa panda ya muhi.

definition.en: A section of stem between two joints, as in sugarcane. The same word names a single cassava tuber.
definition.sw: Kipande cha shina kati ya vifundo viwili, kama ilivyo kwa muwa. Neno hilohilo hutaja kiazi kimoja cha muhogo.
definition.dg: Chipande cha muhi kahi ya mafundo mairi, dza kpwa muwa. Neno hiri piya ni dzina ra chiazi chimwenga cha manga.

notes: Finger segments are also pindi; Pakia suggests it is really a counting word. Mgombato gives a sugarcane pindi as about 15 cm.

definition.en: The knob or stump left on a stem when a branch is cut.
definition.sw: Kinundu au kisiki kinachobaki kwenye shina tawi linapokatwa.
definition.dg: Chipande chinachosala dzulu ya muhi panda ichitemwa.

meaning.en: Also used for the stump of an amputated hand or leg.
meaning.sw: Pia hutumika kwa kisiki cha mkono au mguu uliokatwa.
meaning.dg: Piya nkuhumirwa kpwa chipande chinachosala cha mkpwono au gulu riricholavywa kpwa kutemwa.

notes: Pakia's table glosses it as 'a bulge on stem'; Mgombato as 'tree stump'.

definition.en: A hollow in a trunk or at a cut branch, as often found in muhuhu (Brachylaena huillensis).
definition.sw: Uwazi ndani ya shina au mahali tawi lilipokatwa, kama inavyoonekana mara nyingi katika muhuhu (Brachylaena huillensis).
definition.dg: Kobo ndani ya kolo, au phatu panda iriphotemwa; mara nyinji rinaphahikana kpwa *muhuhu* (*Brachylaena huillensis*).

meaning.en: Cave; any hole or hollow.
meaning.sw: Pango; tundu au uwazi wowote.
meaning.dg: Pango ra mwambani; piya kobo rorosi.

definition.en: A leaf. Each leaflet of a compound leaf counts as its own kodza. Coloured bracts, seed leaves, spines and tendrils are not counted as kodza.
definition.sw: Jani. Kila kijani cha jani changamani huhesabiwa kuwa kodza yake mwenyewe. Majani-ua yenye rangi (bracts), majani ya mbegu, miiba na vitawi-shikizi (tendrils) hayahesabiwi kuwa kodza.
definition.dg: Kodza ra mmea (Chiswahili *jani*). Chila kodza dide ra kodza renye makodza madide manji nkutalwa dza *kodza* rimwenga. *Bracts* za rangi, makodza ga kpwandza ga mmea (*seed leaves*), miya na *tendrils* si *kodza*.

meaning.en: The Digo describe leaves as the plant's clothing (nguo) against the sun, so a tree losing its leaves 'is changing its clothes' (inabadilisha nguo).
meaning.sw: Wadigo huyaeleza majani kuwa ni nguo ya mmea dhidi ya jua, kwa hiyo mti unaopukutisha majani 'unabadilisha nguo' (inabadilisha nguo).
meaning.dg: Adigo nkugomba makodza ni nguwo za mmea (*nguo*) za kuurinda na dzuwa, kpwa hivyo muhi makodzage gachigbwa nkugombwa 'unabadilisha nguwo' (*inabadilisha nguo*).

notes: A Mijikenda word; Swahili kept the older Bantu jani. Mgombato also has likodza (makodza). In ceremonies leaves take other names: maruwa, mashada, vwanda.

definition.en: The veins of a leaf.
definition.sw: Mishipa ya jani.
definition.dg: Mishipa iriyo ndani ya kodza.

meaning.en: Veins (of the body).
meaning.sw: Mishipa (ya mwili).
meaning.dg: Mishipa ya mwiri.

notes: Mgombato has the singular mshipa: vein, tendon, muscle.

definition.en: The main vein down the middle of a leaf.
definition.sw: Mshipa mkuu unaopita katikati ya jani.
definition.dg: Mshipa mkulu unaotsupa kahi-kahi ya kodza.

meaning.en: 'Backbone of the leaf', from its central position and its likeness to a spine.
meaning.sw: 'Uti wa mgongo wa jani', kwa sababu ya kukaa kwake katikati na kufanana kwake na uti wa mgongo.
meaning.dg: 'Mongo wa kodza': nkuihwa hivyo kpwa sababu ya kukala kahi-kahi, na kpwa sababu unaonekana dza uti wa mongo.

notes: Mgombato has mongo: back.

definition.en: The tip of a leaf.
definition.sw: Ncha ya jani.
definition.dg: Ntsa ya kodza.

meaning.en: Sharp end; used for any sharp tip.
meaning.sw: Ncha kali; hutumika kwa ncha yoyote iliyochongoka.
meaning.dg: Ntsa kali; nkuhumirwa kpwa chila ntsa kali.

notes: Pakia recorded no separate word for rounded leaf tips.

definition.en: The stalk of a leaf; the same word is used for the stalk of a fruit or flower.
definition.sw: Kikonyo cha jani; neno hilohilo hutumika kwa kikonyo cha tunda au ua.
definition.dg: Mlita wa kodza; neno hiri piya nkuhumirwa kpwa mlita wa tunda au wa ruwa.

english: leaf stalk (petiole); fruit or flower stalk
notes: Mgombato glosses mlita as 'stalk of a fruit' and gives mgoti with the same meaning.

definition.en: One lobe of a lobed leaf such as cassava's; the lobes are mala ga kodza, 'fingers of the leaf'. Bananas are counted as mala too.
definition.sw: Pindo moja la jani lenye mapindo, kama la muhogo; mapindo hayo huitwa mala ga kodza, 'vidole vya jani'. Ndizi nazo huhesabiwa kama mala.
definition.dg: Seemu mwenga ya kodza renye mala, dza kodza ra manga; seemu hizo nkuihwa *mala ga kodza*, 'vyala vya kodza'. Ndizi nazo nkutalwa dza *mala*.

meaning.en: Finger.
meaning.sw: Kidole.
meaning.dg: Chala cha mkpwono.

notes: Pakia suggests mala is partly a counting word, from the five lobes of a palm-shaped leaf. A lobed leaf is makodza ga mala, 'leaves with fingers' (§3.3.4).

definition.en: A root. The Digo see roots as the plant's mouth (mromo), through which it eats soil and drinks water.
definition.sw: Mzizi. Wadigo huiona mizizi kuwa mdomo wa mmea (mromo), ambao kwa huo hula udongo na kunywa maji.
definition.dg: Muzi wa mmea (mzizi). Adigo anaona mizi ni mromo wa mmea (*mromo*): kpwa mizi, mmea unarya ulongo na kunwa madzi.

meaning.en: Mizi also means stability or permanence: 'akachita mizi', 'he has put down roots'.
meaning.sw: Mizi pia ina maana ya uthabiti au kudumu: 'akachita mizi', 'ameota mizizi' (ametulia mahali).
meaning.dg: *Mizi* piya ina mana ya imara na kukaa kpwa muda mrefu: *'akachita mizi'*, 'akaika mizi'.

notes: The fibres in the middle of a cassava tuber are also mizi.

definition.en: A root tuber, as a general word. Most tubers go by their crop's name (manga, cassava; myogwe, sweet potato; nduma, arrowroot), so viazi is used for the Irish potato, which is new and has no name of its own, and for wild tubers.
definition.sw: Kiazi cha mzizi, kama neno la jumla. Viazi vingi hujulikana kwa jina la zao lake (manga, muhogo; myogwe, kiazi kitamu; nduma, nduma), kwa hiyo viazi hutumika kwa viazi mviringo, ambavyo ni zao jipya lisilo na jina lake, na kwa viazi vya porini.
definition.dg: Neno ra jumla ra chiazi cha muzi. Kpwa viazi vinji nkuhumirwa dzina ra mmea: *manga* (cassava), *myogwe* (sweet potato), *nduma* (arrowroot). Kpwa hivyo *viazi* nkuhumirwa kpwa chiazi cha Ulaya (*Irish potato*), ambacho ni chiphya na tachina dzinare, na kpwa viazi vya weruni.

notes: The Digo class stem tubers such as potatoes with roots, unlike botanists.

definition.en: Small swellings on the roots of legumes and some other plants.
definition.sw: Vinundu vidogo kwenye mizizi ya mimea ya jamii ya kunde na mimea mingine michache.
definition.dg: Vitu vidide vinavyofutuka kpwenye mizi ya mimea ya jamii ya kunde, na ya mimea yanjina.

meaning.en: Charm; probably named for looking like a charm. Mgombato: a charm worn on the neck or arm; also handcuffs.
meaning.sw: Hirizi; huenda vimeitwa hivyo kwa kufanana na hirizi. Mgombato: hirizi inayovaliwa shingoni au mkononi; pia pingu za mikononi.
meaning.dg: Hirizi; labuda zaihwa hivyo kpwa sababu zinaonekana dza hirizi. Mgombato: hirizi inayofungbwa singoni au mkpwononi; piya pingu za askari (*handcuffs*).

notes: The nodules of ndago sedges are made into a charm for strength in danger.

definition.en: A buttress root, the flat wall-like root at the base of some trees. Pakia says the Digo think these grow on rocky soil, where shallow-rooted trees need extra support against the wind.
definition.sw: Mzizi-ukuta, yaani mzizi bapa unaofanana na ukuta chini ya baadhi ya miti. Pakia anasema Wadigo huamini kuwa mizizi hii huota kwenye udongo wenye miamba, ambapo miti yenye mizizi mifupi huhitaji msaada zaidi dhidi ya upepo.
definition.dg: Muzi mpana uimao dza ukuta photsi ya kolo ra mihi yanjina (*buttress root*). Pakia anagomba kukala Adigo anaona mizi hino nkumera kpwenye tsi ya mawe, ambapho mihi yenye mizi isiyoinjira tsini sana inahitaji kugbwirwa zaidi ili iime imara dzulu ya phepho.

notes: Synonyms: ngao ('shield') and mishipa ya mizi, 'neck of the roots' (Pakia also spells it misipha ya mizi), which likens a tree to a person standing on its head.

definition.en: Another word for ngamba, a buttress root.
definition.sw: Neno jingine la ngamba, mzizi-ukuta.
definition.dg: Neno ranjina ra *ngamba*, muzi mpana uimao dza ukuta (*buttress root*).

meaning.en: Shield, for its flat shape and protective role.
meaning.sw: Ngao, kwa sababu ya umbo lake bapa na kazi yake ya kukinga.
meaning.dg: Ngao ya vihani, kpwa sababu ya umbore pana na kaziye ya kurinda.

definition.en: Small cassava or potato tubers; the only description Pakia found for roots in particular.
definition.sw: Viazi vidogo vya muhogo au viazi; maelezo pekee ambayo Pakia aliyapata yanayohusu mizizi hasa.
definition.dg: Viazi vidide vya manga au vya chiazi. Hiri ndiro neno bahi ra kueleza mizi hasa ambaro Pakia waphaha.

meaning.en: Small pieces.
meaning.sw: Vipande vidogo.
meaning.dg: Vipande vidide.

definition.en: A flower. To the Digo a ruwa is a plant part that is colourful or bears fruit: it includes bougainvillea's coloured bracts and the female maize flower, but not the maize tassel.
definition.sw: Ua. Kwa Wadigo, ruwa ni sehemu ya mmea yenye rangi au inayozaa tunda: inajumuisha majani-ua yenye rangi ya bougainvillea na ua jike la mhindi, lakini si ua dume (gunzi la juu) la mhindi.
definition.dg: Ruwa ra mmea (ua). Kpwa Adigo, *ruwa* ni seemu ya mmea yenye rangi au inayolavya matunda: ni phamwenga na *bracts* za rangi za *bougainvillea* na ruwa ra chichetu ra pemba, ela si *punga* ya pemba.

meaning.en: Carries the idea of beauty: maruwa also means ornamental plants, decorative drawings and hair patterns.
meaning.sw: Lina dhana ya urembo: maruwa pia ina maana ya mimea ya mapambo, michoro ya mapambo na mitindo ya nywele.
meaning.dg: Rina mana ya uzuri: *maruwa* piya ni mimea ya mapambo, michoro ya mapambo na mitindo ya nyere.

notes: At funerals, maruwa are the leaves packed around the body (§3.3.3). The papaya's male flower is still a ruwa because it looks like the female.

definition.en: A plume-like flower head: the maize tassel, the panicles of grasses such as Guinea grass and sugarcane, and the coconut's florets.
definition.sw: Shada la maua linalofanana na manyoya: ua dume la mhindi, mashada ya maua ya nyasi kama Guinea grass na muwa, na vijiua vya mnazi.
definition.dg: Maruwa ganagokala dza manyoya dzulu ya mmea: maruwa ga dzulu ga pemba, maruwa ga nyasi dza *Guinea grass* na muwa, na maruwa madide ga mnazi.

meaning.en: Probably from mphunga, rice.
meaning.sw: Huenda limetokana na mphunga, mpunga.
meaning.dg: Labuda neno hiri rinatuluka kula *mphunga*, (mpunga).

notes: Mgombato glosses punga as 'flowers of edible green plants like spinach'.

definition.en: A fruit, but only a fleshy one (berry, drupe, citrus and the like). Dry fruits such as maize cobs, groundnuts and bean pods are not tunda.
definition.sw: Tunda, lakini lenye nyama tu (beri, tunda lenye kokwa, matunda ya jamii ya michungwa na mengineyo). Matunda makavu kama magunzi ya mahindi, karanga na maganda ya maharagwe si tunda.
definition.dg: Tunda, ela renye nyama tu (*berry*, *drupe*, machungbwa na ganjina dza higo). Matunda makavu dza matsere, njugu na makakaya ga maharagbwe si *tunda*.

definition.en: The skin of a fruit or seed, and the peel of a root tuber.
definition.sw: Ganda la tunda au mbegu, na ganda la kiazi cha mzizi.
definition.dg: Seemu ya kondze inayofunika tunda au tembe, na chiazi cha muzi.

definition.en: Wings on winged fruits, as in Gyrocarpus americanus and Combretum schumannii.
definition.sw: Mabawa ya matunda yenye mabawa, kama ilivyo kwa Gyrocarpus americanus na Combretum schumannii.
definition.dg: Mapha ga matunda genye mapha, dza ga *Gyrocarpus americanus* na *Combretum schumannii*.

meaning.en: Wings.
meaning.sw: Mabawa.
meaning.dg: Mapha, dza ga nyuni.

notes: Pakia could not confirm the term, as these trees were uncommon in some study areas.

definition.en: A seed or kernel; more broadly any grain, as in tembe ya tsere (maize grain) and tembe ya mtsanga (grain of soil).
definition.sw: Mbegu au kokwa; kwa upana zaidi, chembe yoyote, kama katika tembe ya tsere (punje ya mhindi) na tembe ya mtsanga (chembe ya udongo).
definition.dg: Tembe ya mmea, au chitsa cha ndani cha tembe (*kernel*); kpwa upana zaidi, chila punje, dza *tembe ya tsere* (punje ya pemba) na *tembe ya mtsanga* (punje ya mtsanga).

notes: The older word is mbeyu, but most Digo now prefer tembe. Seeds of plants with no use are called 'tembe ya/za …', e.g. tembe ya manga, tembe za mvure (§3.3.2).

definition.en: Planting material of any kind: seeds, cuttings (vigoda), seedlings (mitse), banana suckers (mwana) and potato eye buds (dzitso). Seeds meant for eating are not mbeyu.
definition.sw: Mbegu za kupanda za aina yoyote: mbegu, vipandikizi (vigoda), miche (mitse), machipukizi ya mgomba (mwana) na vichipukizi vya viazi (dzitso). Mbegu za kuliwa si mbeyu.
definition.dg: Chochosi chinachophandwa ili kuphaha mmea: tembe, vipande vya mihi (*vigoda*), mimea midide (*mitse*), machipukizi ga ndizi (*mwana*) na matso ga chiazi (*dzitso*). Tembe za kurya si *mbeyu*.

meaning.en: Also used of people for blood lineage.
meaning.sw: Kwa watu pia hutumika kumaanisha ukoo wa damu.
meaning.dg: Piya nkuhumirwa kpwa atu, kpwa mana ya mbari ya mlatso.

notes: Pakia also notes it can stand for tunda, fruit.

definition.en: The embryo of a seed, where visible (maize, beans, mango): the part the new plant grows from. Farmers check it before sowing.
definition.sw: Kiinitete cha mbegu, pale kinapoonekana (mahindi, maharagwe, embe): sehemu ambayo mmea mpya huota kutoka kwake. Wakulima hukikagua kabla ya kupanda.
definition.dg: Seemu ya tembe ambayo mmea muphya unamera kula phapho, ichionekana (pemba, maharagbwe, embe). Akurima nkuilola kabla ya kuphanda.

notes: Mgombato glosses chitsa as 'kernel of maize or nuts' (Swahili nzima). In the coconut the embryo is called mwezi.

definition.en: The embryo of the coconut, and the cotyledon of the mango seed.
definition.sw: Kiinitete cha nazi, na jani la mbegu (kotiledoni) la kokwa ya embe.
definition.dg: *Chitsa* cha nazi, na *cotyledon* ya tembe ya embe.

meaning.en: Moon: the coconut embryo is likened to a full moon, the mango cotyledon to a half moon.
meaning.sw: Mwezi: kiinitete cha nazi hufananishwa na mwezi mpevu, na jani la mbegu la embe hufananishwa na nusu mwezi.
meaning.dg: Mwezi wa dzulu: chitsa cha nazi nkugombwa ni dza mwezi mzima, na *cotyledon* ya embe ni dza *mwezi uphande*.

definition.en: A scar or bud where new growth comes out: the hilum of a bean, the three 'eyes' on a coconut, the eye buds of a potato.
definition.sw: Kovu au kichipukizi mahali ukuaji mpya unapotokea: kitovu cha haragwe, 'macho' matatu ya nazi, vichipukizi vya kiazi.
definition.dg: Tsoga au chimea phatu ambapho mmea muphya unatuluka: *hilum* ya maharagbwe, 'matso' mahahu ga nazi, na matso ga chiazi.

meaning.en: Eye.
meaning.sw: Jicho.
meaning.dg: Dzitso ra mutu (jicho).

definition.en: A seedling or sapling. Most trees, the coconut among them, are named only in two stages: mutse, then the tree's own name.
definition.sw: Mche au mti mchanga. Miti mingi, mnazi ukiwemo, hupewa majina katika hatua mbili tu: mutse, kisha jina la mti wenyewe.
definition.dg: Mtsatsa, mmea mdide wa muhi. Mihi minji, phamwenga na mnazi, nkuihwa kpwa hatua mbiri bahi: *mutse*, na chisha kpwa dzinare.

definition.en: Cuttings used to grow new plants.
definition.sw: Vipandikizi vinavyotumika kuotesha mimea mipya.
definition.dg: Vipande vya mihi vinavyophandwa ili kuphaha mimea miphya.

notes: Pakia gives only the plural.

definition.en: A harmless milky sap, from plants such as Euphorbia hirta (medicinal) and Ficus (used to fix feathers to arrows); also the milky juice of unripe maize grains.
definition.sw: Utomvu mweupe kama maziwa usio na madhara, kutoka kwa mimea kama Euphorbia hirta (ya dawa) na Ficus (hutumika kubandika manyoya kwenye mishale); pia ni maji meupe ya punje za mahindi ambazo hazijakomaa.
definition.dg: Madzi dza maziya ambago tagalumiza mutu, ganagotuluka kpwa mimea dza *Euphorbia hirta* (inayohumirwa dza dawa) na *Ficus* (madzige nkuhumirwa kuika manyoya kpwenye mivi); piya madzi dza maziya ga tembe za pemba mbitsi.

meaning.en: Milk.
meaning.sw: Maziwa.
meaning.dg: Maziya (maziwa).

definition.en: A caustic, toxic oil from unripe cashew fruits and the shell of mature cashew nuts.
definition.sw: Mafuta yanayounguza na yenye sumu kutoka kwa matunda ya korosho ambayo hayajaiva na kutoka kwa ganda la korosho zilizokomaa.
definition.dg: Mafuha ga sumu ganagolumiza ngozi, ganagotuluka kpwa mabibo maitsi na kpwa gada ra ngorosho zirizoivwa.

definition.en: A sticky latex, from Saba comorensis and Landolphia kirkii, used by young people to make sticky bird traps.
definition.sw: Utomvu unaonata, kutoka kwa Saba comorensis na Landolphia kirkii, ambao vijana hutumia kutengeneza mitego ya ndege inayonata.
definition.dg: Utomvu unaonyata, unaotuluka kpwa *Saba comorensis* na *Landolphia kirkii*; barobaro nkuuhumira kuhenda mihambo inayonyata ya kugbwira nyuni.

notes: Mgombato: gum used to catch birds, made by boiling the resin of certain trees.

definition.en: A sticky resin from cashew bark, used as glue.
definition.sw: Utomvu unaonata kutoka kwa gome la mkorosho, unaotumika kama gundi.
definition.dg: Utomvu unaonyata unaotuluka kpwa gopha ra m'bibo, unaohumirwa dza gundi.

meaning.en: From English 'gum'.
meaning.sw: Kutoka neno la Kiingereza 'gum'.
meaning.dg: Rikahalwa kula Chingereza, *gum*.

definition.en: A burning, itching latex, from Euphorbia nyikae and Synadenium, that harms skin and eyes; some use it as fish poison.
definition.sw: Utomvu unaounguza na kuwasha, kutoka kwa Euphorbia nyikae na Synadenium, unaodhuru ngozi na macho; baadhi ya watu huutumia kama sumu ya kuvulia samaki.
definition.dg: Utomvu unaoaka na kuawisa, unaotuluka kpwa *Euphorbia nyikae* na *Synadenium*; unalumiza ngozi na matso, na atu anjina nkuuhumira dza sumu ya kugbwira ng'onda.

notes: Pakia notes the older Bantu word meant sticky birdlime, the sense now carried by ukaka; Mgombato still glosses ulimbo as resin boiled to make bird gum.

definition.en: A deadly toxic latex from Acokanthera schimperi, used as arrow poison.
definition.sw: Utomvu wenye sumu kali inayoua kutoka kwa Acokanthera schimperi, unaotumika kama sumu ya mishale.
definition.dg: Utomvu wa sumu unaoolaga, unaotuluka kpwa *Acokanthera schimperi*, na unahumirwa dza sumu ya mivi.

meaning.en: Bitterness; also poison.
meaning.sw: Uchungu; pia sumu.
meaning.dg: Ladha ya utsungu; piya sumu.

definition.en: A poultice of crushed leaves used as medicine.
definition.sw: Dawa ya kubandika ya majani yaliyopondwa, inayotumika kama tiba.
definition.dg: Dawa ya makodza ga kuphondwa, inayoikpwa dzulu ya mwiri.

notes: Mgombato vwanda (vwanda1) is a traditional ointment for skin diseases such as ringworm; vwanda2 is chewed sugarcane fibre.

definition.en: A medicinal bath of shredded leaves in a pot of water. Also called vuwo.
definition.sw: Dawa ya kuoga ya majani yaliyokatwakatwa ndani ya chungu cha maji. Pia huitwa vuwo.
definition.dg: Madzi ga dawa ga kuoga, ga vipande vidide vya makodza ndani ya nyungu ya madzi. Piya nkuihwa *vuwo*.

meaning.en: Pot.
meaning.sw: Chungu.
meaning.dg: Nyungu (chungu).

notes: A technical word known mainly to healers.

definition.en: Leaves worn under the cap by the groom and his party at a wedding. It is an offence to call them makodza on that occasion.
definition.sw: Majani yanayovaliwa chini ya kofia na bwana harusi na wenzake katika harusi. Ni kosa kuyaita makodza katika tukio hilo.
definition.dg: Makodza ganagoikpwa photsi ya kofiya ni bwana arusi na atue arusini. Ni kosa kugaiha *makodza* wakati uho.

meaning.en: From Arabic shahada, 'declaration'.
meaning.sw: Kutoka neno la Kiarabu shahada, 'tamko (la imani)'.
meaning.dg: Rinatuluka kula Chiarabu *shahada*, 'kutangaza'.

definition.en: The part of a plant eaten as a vegetable side dish; for cassava, only the young leaves. Some vegetables have their own names, e.g. mpeya (cassava leaves) and mtsafwe (cowpea leaves).
definition.sw: Sehemu ya mmea inayoliwa kama mboga ya kitoweo; kwa muhogo, ni majani machanga tu. Mboga nyingine zina majina yake, k.m. mpeya (majani ya muhogo) na mtsafwe (majani ya kunde).
definition.dg: Seemu ya mmea inayoriwa dza mboga; kpwa manga, ni makodza matsanga bahi. Mboga zanjina zina madzina ga chipekee, dza *mpeya* (makodza ga manga) na *mtsafwe* (makodza ga kunde).

definition.en: A fleshy edible mushroom, and in particular its cap, the part eaten. Also called udzondzo.
definition.sw: Uyoga wenye nyama unaoliwa, na hasa kofia yake, ambayo ndiyo sehemu inayoliwa. Pia huitwa udzondzo.
definition.dg: *Uoga* wenye nyama unaoriwa, na hasa kofiyaye, seemu inayoriwa. Piya nkuihwa *udzondzo*.

notes: Also spelled woga (Mgombato's headword). Inedible or non-fleshy ones are woga koma, 'wild mushrooms'. The plural vyoga also names a spotty skin disease.

definition.en: The fleshy, edible part of a mushroom, cap and stem.
definition.sw: Sehemu yenye nyama inayoliwa ya uyoga, yaani kofia na shina.
definition.dg: Seemu ya nyama inayoriwa ya *uoga*, kofiya na muhi.

meaning.en: 'Mushroom meat', for its flesh and taste.
meaning.sw: 'Nyama ya uyoga', kwa sababu ya unyama na ladha yake.
meaning.dg: 'Nyama ya uoga', kpwa sababu ya nyamaye na ladhaye.

definition.en: The stem of a mushroom. Also called mgoti.
definition.sw: Shina la uyoga. Pia huitwa mgoti.
definition.dg: Muhi wa *uoga*. Piya nkuihwa *mgoti*.

meaning.en: Stem of the mushroom.
meaning.sw: Shina la uyoga.
meaning.dg: Kolo ra *uoga*.

notes: Mgombato's mgoti means 'stalk of a fruit'.

definition.en: The gills under a mushroom cap.
definition.sw: Matabaka membamba (gills) yaliyo chini ya kofia ya uyoga.
definition.dg: Misitari iriyo photsi ya kofiya ya *uoga* (*gills*).

meaning.en: Marks.
meaning.sw: Alama.
meaning.dg: Alama.

notes: Few respondents used it, so Pakia could not confirm it is a genuine Digo term.

definition.en: The young stage of a mushroom while the cap is still closed; this is the stage collectors prefer.
definition.sw: Hatua ya awali ya uyoga wakati kofia yake bado imefunga; hii ndiyo hatua wanayoipendelea wanaookota uyoga.
definition.dg: Hatua ya kpwandza ya *uoga*, wakati kofiyaye bado taidzangbwevuguka; ndiyo hatua ambayo atu anaotsola uoga anaipendelea.

definition.en: The later stage of a mushroom once the cap has opened; by then it is often infested by small worms.
definition.sw: Hatua ya baadaye ya uyoga baada ya kofia kufunguka; wakati huo mara nyingi huwa umeshambuliwa na funza wadogo.
definition.dg: Hatua ya badaye ya *uoga*, bada ya kofiyaye kuvuguka; wakati uho mara nyinji unakala na minyoo midide.

meaning.en: Mgombato: bumula, to spread out something folded.
meaning.sw: Mgombato: bumula, kukunjua kitu kilichokunjwa.
meaning.dg: Mgombato: *bumula*, kuvugula chitu chirichokundzwa.
